description: This file implements the FilterListByAnd class, a method operation for the MiniLang language used within the OFBiz framework. It defines how to filter a list of entities by an 'AND' condition based on a provided map, and includes a factory class for creating instances of this operation.

classes.name: FilterListByAnd
classes.description: A method operation that filters a list of entities by an AND condition, based on a provided map of criteria. It retrieves a list and a map via flexible accessors from the environment, applies the AND filtering, and stores the result back into the environment.

methods.name: FilterListByAnd
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation based on the provided XML element and the current simple method context, validating attributes and setting up flexible accessors.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the filtering operation using the environment map, applying the filter criteria to the list of entities.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the operation for debugging purposes.
